words.def_en: probably not honest or true, or feeling doubt

I am dubious about the offer.

words.def_en: unwilling to be calmed or make peace

The storm was implacable for three days.

words.def_en: a sudden violent attack of feeling or illness

She burst into a paroxysm of laughter.

words.def_en: deserving strong criticism

It was a reprehensible failure of duty.

words.def_en: the official power to make legal decisions

The port has its own jurisdiction.

words.def_en: a short fight between small groups

There were skirmishes between rival fans.

words.def_en: to trouble or annoy someone repeatedly

words.def_en: huge and entirely uniform

words.def_en: an angry argument or fight

words.def_en: to block something so that it cannot progress

words.def_en: a rough model of a person, often to be mocked

words.def_en: to openly ignore a rule or law
